subject: Fix hfe no malloc size unit (#2436)
reason: The diff only changes a unit-test mock in src/unit/test_vset.c and adds a build-time guard in src/zmalloc.h that affects which malloc-size macro is compiled on __APPLE__ when NO_MALLOC_USABLE_SIZE is defined (a special test build configuration). On the Linux CI platform the compiled code is byte-for-byte unchanged, and no server command, reply, replication, or persistence behaviour differs between the parent and the change. This is a build/unit-test fix with no runtime behaviour change, so no fuzzer scenario can reach it and none is needed.
